checks.description: line-540 identity k_lat = n - k_fft - k_enum gives k_lat=15

checks.description: the design's sieve dimension m + k_lat equals beta_sieve = 50

checks.description: beta_bkz is irrelevant when beta_sieve = m + k_lat
checks.note: deltaf(beta_bkz)^(m + k_lat - beta_sieve) has exponent 0 here, the same reason BATCH-f75059's KA-5 gave.

checks.description: Nf factorises as prefactor * adjacent-bin term * log-term
checks.note: re-derived independently from the source at lwe_dual.py:551-555 and compared with the callable's own return value.

checks.description: with k_fft = 0 (the BATCH-f75059 design) the term is exactly 1
checks.note: which is why batch 2 could not test it in either direction.

checks.description: ML-KEM-512 adjacent-bin term reproduces the card's 2685.7
